Most health insurance claims get rejected, especially for pre‑existing conditions, so I don’t need my own policy.

chain.why: According to IRDAI Annual Report 2024–25, 87% of health claims were paid and only 8% were rejected, showing that claim rejections are not the norm.

According to IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business, 29 May 2024, after five years of continuous cover an insurer cannot reject a claim for non‑disclosure or misrepresentation (except fraud), limiting denial for pre‑existing issues.

According to ICMR‑INDIAB‑17, Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology, Jul 2023, about 1 in 9 Indian adults have diabetes and more than 1 in 3 have high blood pressure, indicating that many people already have pre‑existing conditions.

conclusion: Since most claims are paid, long‑term personal coverage reduces the chance of denial for pre‑existing conditions, and many adults already have such conditions, having your own health insurance is a prudent safeguard.
